A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

the empirical equations of the parameters of tight binding model and the algorithm of chirality assignment are presented to determine the chirality (m, n) of unknown semiconductoring nanotubes using the first or second transition energy of resonant Raman scattering data.

the empirical equation based chirality assignment technique provides a new method to assign the chirality ( n,m ) of unknown semiconductoring SWNTs by using the first or second transition energies from the experimental resonant Raman scattering data.

it is possible to assign the chiral index of a semiconducting SWCNT from the resonant Raman scattering data of the first and second transition energies using empirical equations.
the chiral index of semiconductors can be easily assigned by solving empirical equations using the first and the second optical transition energies.
chirality assignment of semiconductive SWNT can be achieved with a high degree of accuracy and precision.
